content_blocks.label: clause_1._Premises
content_blocks.text: The Landlord hereby leases to the Tenant the property located at 123 Maplewood Lane, Springfield City, State of Novamont.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Term
content_blocks.text: This Lease shall commence on January 20, 2024, and terminate on January 19, 2025, unless terminated earlier as provided herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Rental
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay rent in the amount of $1,200 per month, payable on the first day of each calendar month.
